assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone environment concept painting for a retro first-person dungeon RPG, Passage Office / Registry in St. Maria. Narrative facts: Registrar Celina asks for the Summoner's seal, not their name, copies it into a narrow ledger whose current page is mostly empty and whose preceding page is full, and issues a Crossing Writ. Scene: a compact colonial Portuguese administrative office, warm limewashed thick masonry, waist-high blue-white azulejo dado, terracotta flooring, dark tropical hardwood, wrought iron, panelled shutters. Strong identity: a substantial worn panelled public-service counter with a recessed writing station, a modest timber-and-iron archive screen behind it, pigeonholes containing folded papers and tied document bundles, upright narrow bound registers ordered by use, a clear place for handing a seal and receiving the writ. The counter and archive storage dominate the room silhouette rather than a freestanding household table and cupboard. Include Celina behind the service counter actively copying a seal impression into the open narrow ledger, and one standing traveler in front for scale. Show deliberate working clutter only: ink, quill, brass seal die with turned wood handle, folded paper writs, corded bundles. Style: polished painterly environment concept with the chunky readable silhouettes and rich restrained textures of late-1990s pre-rendered RPG backgrounds; no photoreal photograph. Composition: landscape panoramic approximately 21:9; near-frontal side-view with modest downward pitch, the entire ONE room visible, a clear horizontal walking strip before the counter and a visible exit threshold. Keep the dominant registry activity in the central region, extension reveals architecture at the sides. Floor near the viewer retains depth and empty walking space, no continuous foreground barrier hiding a person. Lighting: warm practical wall lantern plus soft cool daylight from a shuttered side window falling directly onto the pale open ledger; clear hierarchy, readable wood joinery and paper instead of everything black, no unmotivated cinematic spotlight. Avoid beds, tavern barrels, food displays, generic fantasy wizard study, massive library, religious imagery, glowing runes, floating magic, modern office equipment, text labels, HUD, UI, collage, contact sheet. assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone alternate environment concept image for the Passage Office / Registry in St. Maria, a retro first-person dungeon RPG. The open ledger is long and narrow and clearly paper with visible ruled entries, not a huge spellbook.
